newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Euroyen, Eurodollars up in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Euroyen, Eurodollars up in thin trade.

text.p: SIMEX Euroyen and Eurodollar futures were slightly firmer on Monday in thin, listless trade as interest was cut by a dearth of fresh factors and the absence of many players for year-end holidays.
"People are talking about nothing but Christmas," said a senior Japanese bank dealer. "We really don't have anything much to push the market up or down."
He said the lead September Euroyen contract was likely to trade between 99.22 and 99.28 in the near-term, but added that it showed more of an upside bias.
The contract stood at 99.39 at 1105 GMT against its IMM close at 99.37 after trading in a two-tick band all day. Turnover was a mere 2,710 lots.
Japanese government bond (JGB) futures finished at 125.27 against their previous 125.03.
Eurodollar futures also showed a firm undertone and were underpinned in part by expectations the Federal Reserve would hold short-term rates steady at its meeting on Tuesday.
"Eurodollars are a little firm on the back of economic numbers showing there's no threat of near-term inflation," said the dealer.
He said June Eurodollars looked rangebound between 94.32 and 94.40 as volumes also thinned in Chicago ahead of Christmas.
June Eurodollars ended at 94.37 against their IMM close at 94.36. March were steady at 94.47.
